histogram_semantics: Capture histograms use 757 unique pixel payloads. Diagnostic image-characteristic estimates use unique payloads within the stated group; transaction timing and sequence counts retain all reads. No real images, per-frame features, payload hashes or identifiers.

spectral_direction.semantics: Accepted-window ridge tangent modulo 180 in array coordinates; neither physical finger rotation nor independent windows.

fixed_pixel.statistical_unit: Capture images are unique; diagnostics in this block are USB response occurrences, including repeat payloads. Unique-content estimates and weight sensitivity are in duplicate_sensitivity.fixed_coordinate.

exact_pixel_duplicates.definition: Exact equality of all 12160 image bytes; excludes header, status, BCC, trailing byte and metadata. Counts record occurrences, not independent acquisitions.

correlation.method: local residual normalized sigma=3 floor=20; NCC over actual intersection; all translations; rotations 0:15:345; overlap >=25% or >=50% of 6080 pixels; no quality gate; development diagnostic only

local_features.variant: FAST-9 + custom concentric rings; per-frame p5/p95 mapping; threshold 20; NMS 3; spacing 4; margin 10; max 64; no quality/weak-direction gate

statistical_units.capture_content: One observation per distinct 12160-byte image payload; 757 records and 757 distinct images. Each image has equal weight except explicitly window-weighted spectral estimates.
statistical_units.diagnostic_content: One observation per distinct image payload within each reported experiment/channel; aggregate diagnostics deduplicated across all included channels.
statistical_units.channel_pairs: Deduplicate ordered pairs of original image payloads within each phase; retain actual temporal neighbors. All 28 pairs and 56 images are distinct in the reported comparison.
statistical_units.transaction: Every recorded USB occurrence contributes, including identical responses; do not deduplicate device timing or cancellation outcomes by content.
statistical_units.scope: C: ten-finger captures. D1: GUI comparison and movement only. D2: completed recorded portions of comprehensive validation. Other diagnostic runs are not silently pooled.
